finding.cause: The research/design routes compared IDs, revisions and hashes without binding contract/schema to the independently supplied target record. The earlier commerce recordReference repair and research batch admission repair did not cover these comparisons.
finding.remedy: Keep exact independent lookup; bind actual supported record contract/schema/identity/revision/digest and intended reference field kind across research/design routes. Recompute supplied package, fact and historical design digests without imposing current-use authority on historical records.

independent_disposition.reason: ResearchRequest has no revision field. Its independently trusted descriptor legitimately supplies revision; no record revision may be invented.
independent_disposition.historical_artifacts: preserved byte-exact, including original expected/actual/input hashes

limits: Exact independent descriptors remain necessary for targets without supplied records and for revisions absent from the supplied record.
This does not authenticate the application context or invent a trusted registry, issuer, current status or consumer acceptance.
SC-CHK-009/010, all prior stable finding dispositions and remaining role/acceptance obligations are retained. No old approval transfers to these changed bytes.
Supervisor delivery and fresh whole-PR Astra High review of the exact resulting candidate/archive remain mandatory. No commit, registry release, merge or issue closure is implied.
